title: Compatible Laurent coordinates on a discrete valuation subalgebra
statement: Let $k\subset K$ be fields, $O\subset K$ a $k$-subalgebra that is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and $t\in O$. Put $\kappa=O/\mathfrak m$ and $\widehat O=\varprojlim_n O/\mathfrak m^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. A compatible Laurent coordinate at $t$ is a $k$-algebra isomorphism $c:\widehat O\simeq\kappa[[T]]$ sending $t$ to $T$, whose constant coefficient is the canonical reduction $\widehat O\to\kappa$, together with a $k$-algebra map $j:K\to\kappa((T))$ [def-weil-pbc-laurent-series] such that $j(x)$ is the power-series inclusion of $c(x)$ for every $x\in O$.
